heading: Termination of authority
lead: The authority of the Foundation under this subchapter shall terminate on the date that is 10 years after the establishment of the Foundation, unless the Foundation is reauthorized by an Act of Congress.

notes.text: Codification Section was formerly classified to section 4219 of this title prior to renumbering by Pub. L. 119–65.
